summary.text: Godlike Trojan whom peerless Teucer smote with his bow when Ajax covered him — named among the eight warriors he laid on the bounteous earth in one deadly sequence.

story.text: Teucer brought godlike Lycophontes down after Daetor and Chromius, then Amopaon and Melanippus, one after another, while Agamemnon rejoiced at the havoc wrought in the battalions of the Trojans.
